pieces.Text: While you are in physical contact with nature,

/day you can augment your spells in one of the following ways. 1 power point and expend focus: double duration; 1 power point and expend focus: double range; 1 power point and expend focus: no verbal component; 2 power points and expend focus: no somatic component; 2 power points and expend focus: empower spell
